sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:175957
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 38771 of 2024

Applicant :- Ravindra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Rai
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Amit Rai, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned Aga for the
State.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 50 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC, Police Station Shiwalakala, District Bijnor during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the daughter of the informant on 25.02.2019 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for demand of Rs. 2 lakhs and a motorcycle and on 12.04.2024 they have committed her murder her.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter along with his other family members.

Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46503098/
1 5.

He further submits, actually deceased was short tampered lady and on minor issue very often some quarrel took place between husband and wife on the date of incident, applicant told the deceased not to over involve on her mobile and due to this reason she started making quarrel and thereafter applicant had gone for his job of labour and behind him in anger she committed suicide by hanging herself.

6. He further submits, the fact that deceased was short tampered lady and she used to over involve in her mobile all the time, is evident from the statement of independent witnesses, which have been annexed at page-68 onwards.
He further submits, even post mortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

7. He further submits, immediately after the incident informant was informed and he arrived at spot and he was one of the witness of inquest but at that time he did not raise any objection and next day he lodged the FIR of the present case and this fact suggests that after due consultation on the basis of false allegation, FIR of the present case was lodged.
He further submits, inquest of the deceased has been annexed at page-32 of the paper book.

8. He next submits, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 15.04.2024 i.e. for last more than six months.
9.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within five years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that from the post mortem report, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death and from the statements of independent witnesses it reflects that deceased was short tampered lady and often fight took place between husband and wife.
10.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within five years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but from the statements of the independent witnesses, which have been annexed along with instant bail application, it reflects that deceased was reluctant to perform her matrimonial duties and she always involved in her mobile and considering these statements, the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant with regard to alleged suicide committed by his wife cannot be completely ruled out at this stage.
12. Further, post mortem report also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

Further, from the inquest report it reflects that informant was present at the time of inquest and he was one of the inquest witness but at that time he did not raise any objection and next day he lodged FIR of the present case.
13. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 15.04.2024 i.e. for last more than six months.

Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46503098/
2 14.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

16. Let the applicant - Ravindra be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 11.11.2024 AK Pandey  Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46503098/
